q2_gaps: a temporal SPAN preposition on an eventuality ('hunt ... through summer') has no carrier: During is restricted to exactly during/while/throughout, Every/TimesPer need a stated period or rate, and a bare Time filler records only which period, dropping the across-the-whole-span reading
notes: 'often' is handled exactly per the frequency dial — rule strength 0.8 plus the QuantifierPhrase companion naming the word — and the bare-plural habitual correctly becomes a distributing rule with a Skolem-function event and no status atom. A bare season symbol in a Time slot is only exemplified in its deictic forms (last spring / next summer), but 'a deictic or named time stays a bare symbol' covers it.
